21 years after Hagia Sophia was finished, its dome fell in. 🏛️ Watch it rise in 17 seconds. ⏱️

After riots burned the old church in 532, Emperor Justinian ordered a new one, and more than 10,000 people built it in under 6 years. Four giant piers, curved pendentives that turn a square into a circle, and a dome about 32 m wide ringed with windows.

The twist: earthquakes cracked the dome and in 558 it collapsed. It was rebuilt with lighter materials and about 6 m higher, the dome that still stands today.

Would you have rebuilt it or started over? 👇

yt_title: Hagia Sophia's Dome Fell 21 Years After It Was Built #shorts
yt_description:
Justinian I began Hagia Sophia on 23 Feb 532, weeks after the Nika riots burned the previous church; architects Anthemius of Tralles and Isidore of Miletus; more than 10,000 workers; inaugurated 27 Dec 537 (5 years 10 months). The dome sits on pendentives. Earthquakes cracked it and in 558 part of it collapsed; Isidore the Younger rebuilt it lighter and ~6.25 m higher, completed 562. Minarets were added after 1453.

Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hagia_Sophia · https://www.britannica.com/topic/Hagia-Sophia
